lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The study was locked from the inside. The key lay on the desk.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He never opened the door.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Aldous Crane, a publisher, went into his study at nine. At half past ten, he had not come out.

lines.speaker: Inspector Dale
lines.text: The window latch was shut. The only key was on his desk. Nobody could have gone in or out.

lines.speaker: Kiri
lines.text: Nothing is impossible. Something is just hidden.

lines.speaker: Inspector Dale
lines.text: Crane's wristwatch stopped at nine-forty. So we think that is when it happened.

lines.speaker: Kiri
lines.text: Stopped. But the clock on the shelf is still running.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: First, Dr. Voss, Crane's doctor. He came at nine for a check-up and left the study at twenty past.

lines.speaker: Dr. Voss
lines.text: At nine-forty I phoned the hospital from this very phone. The switchboard keeps a log.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: From nine to ten I counted the silver with Mrs. Pell, the cook. We never left the kitchen.

lines.speaker: Felix
lines.text: I was at the village cinema from nine. Here is my ticket. The usher saw me all night.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: One. A tiny drop of red wax on the door frame, level with the lock.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Two. A blue fibre caught on the ring of the key.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Three. A wristwatch stopped at nine-forty, glass unbroken, while the clock on the shelf still runs.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Pause the video if you want to guess. Who made a plan?

lines.speaker: Kiri
lines.text: The wax first. The only red sealing wax in this house is in one bag.

lines.speaker: Kiri
lines.text: The fibre. Not wool, not cotton. Blue nylon thread, the kind in a spool.

lines.speaker: Kiri
lines.text: And the key was never in the lock. Why would a thread go through its ring?

lines.speaker: Kiri
lines.text: Who needs it to be nine-forty? Only someone who is safe at nine-forty.

lines.speaker: Kiri
lines.text: Dr. Voss left the study at twenty past nine. His only alibi starts at nine-forty.

lines.speaker: Kiri
lines.text: Here is how the door was locked. Step one. A latch bar inside the door, lifted, with a thread tied to it.

lines.speaker: Kiri
lines.text: Step two. The thread runs through the ring of the key.

lines.speaker: Kiri
lines.text: Step three. Outside, pull the thread. The key is a weight. The bar drops, and the door is fast.

lines.speaker: Kiri
lines.text: Step four. Let go. The thread slips out through the gap, dragged by the falling key, which lands on the desk.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The spool was blue. The thread matched the fibre. The wax matched the drop.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The motive is two lines long. Crane was about to print a story about Voss.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He did not want the world to read it. So he planned a door nobody could open.

lines.speaker: Kiri
lines.text: Which clue did you notice first?

scenes.title: The locked door
scenes.place: A shadowy hallway outside a heavy oak study door, a brass lamp glowing at the far end

scenes.title: The study
scenes.place: Inside Aldous Crane's study, a dark wooden desk with a lamp, a brass key on a green blotter, a clock ticking on the shelf

scenes.title: Dr. Voss
scenes.place: The grand hallway of Crane's house at night, a medical bag on a chair beside a hall telephone

scenes.title: Mara
scenes.place: A busy farmhouse kitchen at night, a cook stirring a pot, silver spoons laid out on a long table

scenes.title: Felix
scenes.place: A small village cinema lobby, a ticket booth, a red ticket stub in a young man's hand

scenes.title: Three clues
scenes.place: A close view of the study door frame and the desk, with a magnifying glass hovering over a tiny spot of red wax

scenes.title: The wax
scenes.place: A close view of the door frame, a drop of red wax shining beside a small iron latch bar

scenes.title: The thread
scenes.place: A close view of the brass key on the green blotter, a single blue fibre across its ring

scenes.title: The watch
scenes.place: A close view of Crane's silver wristwatch on the desk, the hands stopped, the glass shining and whole

scenes.title: The trick
scenes.place: A re-enactment drawing of the study door from the outside, a long blue thread running from the latch bar through a key ring to a wax guide on the frame

scenes.title: The hall
scenes.place: The hallway again at dawn, the medical bag open on a chair and a spool of blue thread on top

scenes.title: Why
scenes.place: A quiet study at sunrise, a manuscript on the desk with a single page lifted by the draught
